source: User feedback during accepted IFX 0.10.0 human review
boundaries: Do not modify immutable 0.10.0 packages, tags or release attachments.
Core remains independent of CLI/Web and consumer installation.
Keep existing policy scope, case identities, offline sources, host safety and loopback authentication/lifecycle.

items.title: Include the Web component in the NuGet Workbench distribution
items.observation: The released CLI tool package has no Web payload. Its ui/launch entries require an adjacent Web payload or development checkout; the accepted independent Windows installation supplies it.
items.proposedScope: Design a unified-version NuGet delivery that supplies and resolves the matching Web host, contracts, dependencies and static assets without a separate Workbench installation or source checkout. Bundled assets versus an automatically resolved companion package remain a design decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Cold install/restore from an explicit approved feed can start ui and launcher with the approved SDK/runtime and no separate Web installation or source build.
The resolved Web payload and static assets match the unified product version, provenance, package approval and notices.
Offline operation has no hidden download or fallback to an unrelated installed Web component.
Missing, changed or mismatched Web payloads fail clearly; CLI-only architecture use remains compatible.
Loopback/token protection, safe shutdown, upgrade/rollback and both entrance lifecycles pass; do not repair persistent PATH/environment.
items.designDecision: Bundle complete matching framework-dependent Web in ArchSift.Cli; explicit portable Launcher state/config context; retain managed Setup protection.

items.title: Make Architecture tests JSON inventory collapsible
items.observation: The inventory renders each ruleset and all case IDs as flat rows. With 401 JSON cases the page becomes long. Existing collapsible result groups are a different surface.
items.proposedScope: Use compact per-ruleset disclosure groups with visible paths/names and case counts, initially collapsed; provide expand/collapse-all controls and preserve access to copy/edit actions.
acceptanceCriteria: The 401-case inventory is readable without scrolling through every case; the 92 C# and responsibility/deferred summaries stay clear.
Disclosure controls work with keyboard/screen readers and both existing locales; focus and sensible disclosure state survive refresh/locale changes.
Expanding exposes every original case ID and rule path; empty/disabled/error states remain clear.
Collapse affects presentation only: complete execution still runs all 493 cases, with unchanged selection, coverage, report bytes and rule authority.
Existing external-copy/edit flows and source-read-only boundaries remain intact.
items.designDecision: Initially collapsed native ruleset disclosures; visible paths/counts/actions; JSON-only bulk controls; session state/focus preservation.
